inputs.text: {"high_level_description": "Empty Bloodridge sunken crypt battle stage, rendered entirely in crisp, deliberately clustered pixel art. Bright storybook fantasy strategy game look: clean bold readable shapes, warm saturated sandstone, mossy green on the ruins and the roots, a pale blue sky, spooky but cheerful. One single continuous 2.5D battle scene, no figures, no text.", "style_description": {"medium": "pixel_art", "art_style": "Authentic hand-pixelled 2D game background. Visible square pixel clusters and stair-stepped contours everywhere. Muted limited palette, flat colour clusters, two or three discrete shades per stone. Organic uneven shapes with carefully chipped corners. Broad quiet surfaces with occasional short angular cracks. Crisp pixel edges without antialiasing. The controlled pixel craft of an old burial court: irregular broad paving stones, shallow angular shadows, weathering only on selected edges. No paint brushwork, no gritty texture layer, no dithering, no gradients.", "aesthetics": "readable 2.5D battle stage, storybook bright, coherent pixel clusters", "lighting": "Clear daylight from the upper left as discrete flat pixel colour planes, crisp shadow shapes. Bright even fighting ground.", "color_palette": ["#3b2a24", "#6b4a34", "#a8744a", "#d8a46a", "#f0d29a", "#6f8a3a", "#a8c060", "#bfe0ea"]}, "compositional_deconstruction": {"background": "One continuous 2.5D side view battle stage seen from a fixed oblique camera, no figures. The upper part: the sunken crypt of Bloodridge, a ruined stone crypt doorway in the middle with heavy pillars, a broken lintel and two worn steps, its inside dark; rubble terraces and broken stairs on the left; an old wall gripped by huge twisting tree roots on the right; above them a strip of sky over a distant ridge with a small stepped pyramid court. The lower half: one wide flat courtyard of broad worn paving stones, quiet and even so small fighters read on it.", "elements": [{"type": "obj", "bbox": [0, 300, 380, 660], "desc": "the ruined stone crypt doorway with heavy pillars, a broken lintel and two worn steps, dark inside"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [40, 0, 360, 310], "desc": "rubble terraces and broken stone stairs"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [30, 640, 400, 1000], "desc": "an old stone wall gripped by huge twisting tree roots"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [380, 0, 1000, 1000], "desc": "a wide flat courtyard of broad worn paving stones, calm and even"}]}}
